description: Textures, hdris and models the dressing layer may use, with licence, source and md5. No downloads are made from this repo.

membrane_hf_1.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, top-down orthographic view of an abstract wet organic membrane surface: soft folds, fine branching vessel-like lines, subtle fibrous striations, glossy moist sheen. Muted dusky rose and violet-grey tones, flat even lighting, no shadows, no perspective. Abstract material swatch only: no anatomy, no organs, no faces, no figures, no creatures, no blood, no gore, no text.
